fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 46% match is a weak fit for this Datadog Marketing Operations Associate role right now.

**Strengths:**
- Mailchimp email campaigns and Hootsuite scheduling from your Harbor Street internship
- Google Analytics, Instagram Insights and Excel for campaign reporting
- B.A. Communications plus HubSpot Content Marketing course (2024)

**Gaps:**
- No Marketo, Eloqua or Salesforce experience, and no HTML
- No B2B technology experience; your background is retail and student society
- No lead database segmentation or email compliance knowledge

**Recommendation:** Build hands-on Marketo and HubSpot skills with certifications and a segmented-email project, then apply to B2B marketing operations roles.

coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

A campaign only performs if the right audience sees the right message, and the list behind it is where that starts. At Harbor Street Pet Supply, I sent one newsletter a week and grew our list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers by adding a sign-up QR code at the till. That habit of treating the audience as something you build and check is what I'd bring to Datadog's global email program.

As a Marketing Intern, I wrote and scheduled our emails in Mailchimp, and I read Google Analytics and Instagram Insights to see what people responded to. I also ran the Westbrook Film Society's Instagram and TikTok accounts, where a weekly reel took average screening ticket sales from 35 to 60. I work in Excel, I hold a B.A. in Communications, and I've completed a HubSpot Content Marketing course. I haven't used Marketo yet, but I'm keen to learn it, and the hands-on email and reporting work I've done is a solid base for the campaign execution and performance reporting you describe. Your note that you hire people who will grow into the role is why I'm applying with confidence.

Supporting the APJ Marketing team through Campaign Operations is the kind of detail-focused, cross-team work I want to build my career on. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help, and I'm available to start discussions at your convenience.

Best regards,
Maya Linden
